definitions.explanation: Refers to a reciprocal relationship between two or more parties.
Used adverbially to describe actions done by both parties.

examples.japanese: お{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}いましょう→助け合う：04654_tasukeau⟧。
お{互|たが}い⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: We're in the same boat. / It's mutual.

examples.japanese: お{互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
お{互|たが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We try to understand each other.

examples.japanese: お{互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長所|ちょうしょ}→長所：03121_chousho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}め{合|あ}う→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
お{互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。

examples.japanese: お{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}りましょう→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{互|たが}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (mutually - adverbial use)
- お{互|たが}い⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ (we're even/mutual - set phrase used when both parties share a burden)
- お{互|たが}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (each other's ~)

Note: The お prefix is standard and rarely omitted; ⟦{互|たが}い→互い：03402_tagai⟧ alone sounds unnatural in most contexts.

USAGE:
お{互|たが}い⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧ is a polite expression acknowledging that both parties are equally affected or responsible. It's commonly used as a humble response to apologies or thanks.

Compare with ⟦{相互|そうご}→相互：04045_sougo⟧ (mutual/reciprocal), which is more formal and used in written/official contexts.
